entities.text:
High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Indore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Shri Manish Yadav - Advocate for the applicant.

Shri Ashish Joshi, learned counsel for the respondent [
Shri Tarun Pagare Ga for the State.

1.  This is second application filed under section 483 of the BNSS, 2023 for grant of bail in connection with Crime No. 31/2024 registered at Police Station - S.T.F. Ujjain, District - Ujjain (M.P.) for offence punishable under Sections 420, 468, 471, 120B of the IPC and under Section 66-D of the Information Technology Act.
He is in custody since 25/09/2024 2.
As per the case of prosecution, the applicant with other accused has cheated the complainant and others to allure them to allot flats under the scheme of Pradhanmanti Aavas Yojna.
The applicant has defrauded the complainants and received money to the tune of Rs. 64,54,863/- through online/digital system.
3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is suffering from serious ailment.
He is on ventilator presently at District hospital Ujjain.
4. This Court vide order dated 23.09.2025 passed in MCRC no. 37357/2025 had requested the State to requisition the medical and health status of the applicant from the Central Jail Ujjain.
5. Learned counsel for the State informs that as per the report of 2 MCRC-37383-2025 MGM Medical Super Speciality Hospital Indore, the applicant is in Cardiac ICU and is recovering from the surgery.

entities.text: MGM Medical Super Speciality Hospital Indore
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: He requires ICU care for another 3- 4 days.
6. Accordingly, this Court, vide order dated 26/09/2025 passed in MCRC no. 37357/2025 extended conditional ad-interim bail for in-house treatment of the applicant.

7. Considering this aspect of the matter, the request for temporary bail is allowed and it is hereby Avinas Rao vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/17477439/
1 directed that subject to deposit of cash amount of Rs.50,000/- in the trial Court, the applicant shall be released on temporary bail a period of 01 month(one month) from the date of his release on bail for treatment as an indoor patient at any Medical Centre or Nursing Home , on his furnishing personal bond of Rs.2,50,000/- (Rupees Two Lakhs Fifty thousand only) with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the Court concerned.

entities.text: Avinas Rao vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Applicant shall submit copy of his medical status and treatment papers, as inhouse patient, on Monday of every week before the trial Court.
If he is discharged from Medical Centre/ Nursing Home before expiry of one month, he shall immediately surrender to custody of concerned Court/ Supdt. of concerned Jail.
The applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated u/S 437(3) of Cr.P.C. during period of bail.
In case of failure to comply the order within 03 days or violation of any condition of bail, this temporary bail order shall automatically stand cancelled and the amount shall be forfeited.
8. The applicant shall surrender before the trial Court on or before expiry of period of 01 month(one month).
The cash amount be returned to 3 MCRC-37383-2025 the applicant on surrender, else it will be forfeited.
Necessary papers regarding surrender and treatment of the applicant be furnished to this Court.

9. List the matter after one month.
C.C. as per rules.
(SANJEEV S KALGAONKAR) JUDGE amol Avinas Rao vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 8 October, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/17477439/
